description: This file defines the 'Transaction' entity class in a Java-based e-commerce system, representing financial transactions related to orders. It includes fields for transaction details such as amount, date, type, payment method, and associated order, along with auditing and JSON serialization capabilities.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Entity class representing a financial transaction, including details such as amount, date, type, payment method, and associated order, with auditing and JSON serialization features.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the audit information for this transaction.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit information for this transaction.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the transaction.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the transaction.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves the associated order for this transaction.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Associates an order with this transaction.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Gets the amount involved in the transaction.

methods.name: setAmount
methods.description: Sets the amount involved in the transaction.

methods.name: getTransactionDate
methods.description: Retrieves the date when the transaction occurred.

methods.name: setTransactionDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the transaction.

methods.name: getDetails
methods.description: Returns additional details of the transaction.

methods.name: setDetails
methods.description: Sets additional details of the transaction.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the transaction details map into a JSON-formatted string.
